scientific_integrity: All-length proof is supplied; bounded computational checks are supplementary and independent scientific validation has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: Classification applies to finite linear binary words and forbids mixed Abelian squares only, not monochromatic factors; cannot establish the conjectured overall minimum abelian-square occurrence count. title: Exact composition-refined census of binary words avoiding mixed Abelian squares
